summary: This Form 6-K reports a private placement of units by Digital Currency X Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer. On June 24, 2026, the company entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with investors to issue 331,753,557 units at $2.11 per unit, each unit consisting of one ordinary share and three warrants with an exercise price of $2.11. The placement closed July 3, 2026, raising $700 million for working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring.
